decision_rule.band: 1.4826*MAD/2 of err_A - err_B over every hypothesis, A/B = quarters of the fit half
decision_rule.determined: values within band of the best error, other parameters at the argmin
decision_rule.resolved: the per-seed boolean is the same on all three hidden seeds
decision_rule.seeds: NOT paired: collect() draws sim.rng every tick for the push test, mode-dependently inside Excitation and once per episode in fresh(); three seeds answer whether the verdict holds on every seed, not whether a mean is significant
decision_rule.noise_floor: |err(nominal candidate) - err(second nominal candidate, other collection seed)| on the same hidden log; a separation below it is not evidence
decision_rule.null_case: nominal hidden body must identify to (0, 0) on every seed (asserted)
